messages:
violet: Quick heads-up: opened a small PR to clarify burst credit behavior on the pricing+quota pages and to add cross-language SDK parsing examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6789. Main goals: 1) show a concise rule-of-thumb for burst vs sustained traffic, 2) remove any leftover `x-rw-usage` samples, and 3) fix the dashboard permalink.

samir: Nice. Can we include a one-line decision heuristic? e.g., 'If request size < avg_request and remaining_burst > avg_request_tokens -> batch aggressively; else prefer streaming.' That helps support.

anya: Also add a tiny test fixture suggestion for snippet-lint so examples don't bitrot (sample JSON with consumption.summary + tiers). I can add that in a follow-up SDK PR.

violet: Added a short heuristic paragraph and three snippets (curl + python + node) showing safe parse patterns. Also replaced hard pricing numbers with variables like {cost_per_norm_unit} and linked the canonical pricing matrix.

samir: Heads-up: SDK responses now include consumption.summary.normalized_remaining; prefer that over scanning tiers to avoid miscounts. I left an inline suggestion to show both patterns.

anya: Good. Please also call out eventual consistency: quota pulses may lag ~30-90s after large refills. Add a troubleshooting bullet: re-query after 60s if numbers look off.

infra-bot: INFRA-1142: please include panel UID for Grafana permalink and confirm hosted vs private differences.

violet: Included panel UID in PR (panel-usage-cc) and pinged eng-infra for confirmation. Pushed compact examples; sample python snippet below for review:

```python
# safe parse: prefer summary, else sum tiers
resp = requests.get(quota_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"})
data = resp.json()
remaining = data.get("consumption", {}).get("summary", {}).get("normalized_remaining")
if remaining is None:
    remaining = sum(t.get("remaining", 0) for t in data.get("consumption", {}).get("tiers", []))
# heuristic: batch_size = min(max_batch, remaining // avg_tokens_per_request)
```

samir: Looks good. One nit: don't use the literal endpoint in inline text; make it a variable {quota_endpoint} so self-hosted customers know it can differ.

anya: Approved on docs side after tiny wording tweak. I can follow up with a fixture for the snippet tests.

infra-bot: ENG-INFRA confirmed the permalink works for hosted customers; private installs may vary—tracking INFRA-1142.

docs-bot: PR opened by violet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6789 — reviewers requested: @samir, @anya. Checks queued: linkcheck, snippet-lint, spellcheck.

violet: Merging once CI passes and infra confirms. Will post brief migration blurb in #release-notes and open SDK PR to update sample parsing. Closing loop after merge. :thumbsup:
